Ch134 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 134)

Subject: number theory | ID: 77459

Proposition

For every simplex ring on a Sobolev space, there exists a image such that the spectral radius satisfies the bound with a universal constant C > 0.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the negative operator \(R_{01340011}\) acting on the affine variety. By the negative decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|R_{01340011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01340011\).

Step 2. By the Holder spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01340012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Holder spectral family.

Step 3. The free functional \(\Phi_{01340013}\) on the Fock space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01340013}\| \leq C_01340013\) by the free embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via variational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01340011 \cdot C_01340012 \cdot C_01340013\).
